description_expanded: Favorite Features - Beachfront - Private Pool - Golf Cart included in the amenity package More about PoppyLu - Blue Mountain Beach Vacation House PoppyLu is a newly renovated oceanfront home located in the quiet beach community of Blue Mountain Beach. This stunning three-story home sits directly on the beach with private beach access and is located near the rare coastal dune lake, Big Redfish Lake. This luxurious home has recently undergone a complete transformation and boasts maximized Gulf views and high-end finishes. Guests can relax in the private pool or walk down the private beach access to an exceptionally deep beach and see rare phenomena where the lake meets the Gulf! PoppyLu is the perfect home for your beach getaway whether you're searching for a romantic rendezvous or a family gathering spot, this home is sure to please! Located in a quiet cul-de-sac, guests will be swept into tranquility from the moment they arrive onto this property.  Outside, a charming stucco exterior sets the tone for the rest of the home. The palm trees surrounding the front of the home assist with easing guests into paradise. A spacious driveway and garage provide parking space for up to five cars. Notably, the front doors of this home brings a touch of history with historical lineage that can be traced back to a British fort in India.  Inside, marble floors and custom high-end finishes fill this beach house. The first floor invites guests to prepare cuisine in the gourmet kitchen and relax in the living room while admiring the gulf views. The kitchen is finished with marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a wine cabinet. The separate butler’s pantry offers a private quarter to prepare light fare while entertaining friends and family. Moreover, the open floor plan allows for views into the dining and living room space. Expansive windows cover the backside of the house, allowing for natural light to fill both of these spaces so guests can dine or relax with unforgettable views.  PoppyLu sleeps up to 21 guests-- with plenty of sleeping arrangements for everyone. Upstairs, five bedrooms and four and a half private bathrooms await. The first bedroom boasts a king-sized bed, a private bathroom, and a balcony with stunning views overlooking the backyard. The second bedroom offers a king-sized bed with a spacious ensuite bathroom. The third bedroom, a master bedroom, offers a spacious suite to kick back and relax in. This master bedroom boasts expansive views of the Gulf of Mexico, and a cozy sitting area. The ensuite in the master bedroom features Calcutta-marble double vanities and a spa bath that overlooks the Gulf. Additionally, a bunk room is located on the second floor, perfect for small children that need to stay close. This bunk room features one set of triple double bunks and one set of triple twin bunks. The final bedroom on the third floor offers two queen beds and an ensuite bathroom.  In addition to all PoppyLu has to offer, the location is a prime spot for a relaxing vacation.  Blue Mountain Beach is one of the most desired vacation spots along Scenic Highway 30A. This laid-back atmosphere offers delicious local restaurants, quiet beaches, and trail entrance access into the Point Washington State Forest. If you are ready to relax on the beach, you came to the right place. Book your stay today! Sleeping Arrangements: SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Shared Balcony & Gulf View. Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: Full over Full over Full Bunk, Twin over Twin over Twin Bunk & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: King Bed with Sitting Area & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Additional Arrangements: Queen Sleeper Sofa THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: 2 Queen Beds with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub.  Private Balcony & Gulf View.
